verdict.rationale: Highnote supports rule-based automation that runs without human intervention — spend rules and velocity controls automatically approve/decline authorizations in real time, webhooks/notifications trigger on events, and the agentic-commerce docs describe cards being auto-issued per agent/workflow and auto-closing when the workflow ends. This covers background autonomous decisioning within the payments domain but is narrower than a general-purpose automation/orchestration capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration, evidence of broader multi-step or scheduled automation beyond authorization-time rules.
